title: Kong key-auth (header only) with explicit credential inclusion
claims: with explicit credential inclusion, a synthetic key-auth key admits exactly the matching apikey header
a missing or wrong key is not forwarded
the synthetic key never appears in the report, settings or converter output streams
not_claimed: hide_credentials, anonymous consumers, ACL group mapping
source_semantics: Kong key-auth with key_names=[apikey], header lookup only: a missing key and an invalid key both return 401 in Kong 3.x without contacting the upstream; a valid key is proxied. Documentation-inferred unless the upstream differential runs.
